domain.text: Software engineering: fixing per-item GitHub project-board lookups and validating issue creation and board updates.

impressions.text: The delivery replaced lagging project-listing lookups with issue-side membership lookups for per-item writes, while retaining listing scans for board-wide operations.
The final worker report documents broad automated validation, including 1,313 passing tests and successful format, lint, typecheck, build, and smoke checks.
The initial worker stopped as blocked after its change caused 24 housekeeping test failures; the orchestrator switched models and directed fixture updates and an acceptance regression test.

The worker could not perform live acceptance because its gateway operation was denied, so live validation was escalated to the orchestrator, who later reported successful live creation and an immediate board update.

roundCauses.text: The first worker stopped as blocked after 24 fixture-related housekeeping test failures; the orchestrator switched to sol and assigned fixture updates and acceptance coverage.
